mutations.label: N1 the conditional is INVERTED: the sentence names a raised exception when none was recorded, and says 'no capture exception was recorded ... (unverified)' when one was -- #949's exact subject, mis-attribution, which is worse than silence because it sends the reader to the app. Both arms stay present, so the AST one-conditional check holds. RE-AIMED at #1203pg's owner.
mutations.replace: + (" — the capture raised %s" % _why if not _why else

mutations.label: N2 the count is off by one, so '0 of M screen(s) photographed' understates what was attempted
mutations.find: return ("capture unavailable — 0 of %d screen(s) photographed; not judged" % attempted
mutations.replace: return ("capture unavailable — 0 of %d screen(s) photographed; not judged" % (attempted - 1)

mutations.label: N3 the error list is capped at ZERO, so a round whose captures all raised reports 'the capture raised' followed by nothing but the cut note (#1034)
